Bounded-span method throughout the book: spans are explicitly defined by a starting phrase and ending phrase ('from X to Y') before any count is taken -- observed repeatedly (p.13 Erechin, p.18 Levite passage, p.82 refuge-city boundaries).

The detailed letter-table's ט-נ interval (pp.37-38) could not be reliably parsed into distinct, ordered letter-paragraphs in Task-2's pass -- apparent repeated sightings of letters resembling Yod and Mem. This is a TRANSCRIPTION exception (a limitation of this inventory's reading), not a claimed source-level exception -- flagged separately from E-01 through E-05 which ARE the author's own stated exceptions.
